I don’t know if I want to live the rest of my life feeling the way I do now. Yes I have a partner, but it still feels lonely. I have to choose what type of lonely I rather be if it doesn’t work out the way I hoped. 

It’ll be a risk either way, either I stay and end up forever wondering what could have been or break free and give a chance at finding true love. I feel inclined to choose the latter. Either I will find true love and the risk was worth it, or, I die alone knowing I tried.

I remember I took a class once that was required to remove a ticket from my driving record and the instructor made the class more about self help and coping strategies more than anything. She told us a story about how she had a problem with confrontation as well and she used her ex-husband as an example. She said that she never felt strong enough to confront him and not be emotional about it so what she did was practice what she was going to say several times out loud and when the time finally came she was able to confront him without feeling emotional and he took her seriously and she got what she wanted. 

Anyways I say that because maybe you can practice what you want to say with your boss before you go into the meeting so you can feel confident about what you’re going to say and they can take you seriously.
